value: Law No. 164 of 2025 applies to premises leased for residential purposes, and premises leased to natural persons for non-residential purposes, under Law 49 of 1977 and Law 136 of 1981 (Art. 1). It is a transitional law for old leases, not a general tenancy code.
source_publisher: Presidency of the Republic of Egypt (published on the Information and Decision Support Center repository)
note: Law No. 164 of 2025 (issued 4 August 2025), English text on a government repository. It covers only old leases governed by Law 49 of 1977 and Law 136 of 1981, not new leases. Implementing decisions of governors and the Cabinet, and the Civil Code rules for new leases, were not checked. The Arabic text prevails.

value: Residential lease contracts under the law terminate seven years after the law takes effect; leases to natural persons for non-residential use terminate after five years, unless the parties agree an earlier end (Art. 2).

value: From the first monthly rent after the law takes effect, the legal rent in prime areas is twenty times the current legal rent, with a minimum of EGP 1,000; in moderate and economic areas it is ten times, with minimums of EGP 400 (moderate) and EGP 250 (economic). Until governorate committees finish classifying areas, tenants pay EGP 250 a month and later pay any difference in instalments (Art. 4).
